title: Space before is dropped at a forced page top; an empty pageBreakBefore paragraph after a break is just an empty paragraph
source: pbb_probe.pdf re-measured 2026-10-22: Letter, TNR, docDefaults without w:sz (10pt), 14pt before=400 after=200 headings; glyph tops (baseline - 12.4): p1 A1 72.56, p2 A2 104.0 (72 + 11.51 empty + 20), p3 B2 72.56 (before dropped), p4 C2 104.0 (empty pageBreakBefore paragraph = an empty paragraph), p5 D2 104.0

cases.note: A2 after a break-only paragraph + empty paragraph: 72 + 11.51 + 20
